bio.title: Introduction
bio.text: I'm passionate about images and the feeling they give off. I've decided to make it my full-time profession in 2019. Field experience has taught me to capture the present moment. Both photography and video are universal languages that allow us to exchange ideas all over the world. What I appreciate most in my job is that a project can speak for itself through an image alone.

bio.title: My biography
bio.text:
Cynthia's story with photography began in 2016, when she acquired her first camera. This step marked the beginning of an exciting journey through the lens, inspired by her desire to capture life's fleeting moments and raw emotions. 
 Over the years, Cynthia has honed her craft by exploring diverse landscapes and immortalizing precious moments, whether at lively festivals, vibrant concerts or in the heart of nature. Her experiences in digital media, combined with constant freelance practice, have enabled her to develop a unique visual signature, combining sensitivity and technical mastery.
 But for Cynthia, photography is more than just a craft: it's a powerful way of telling stories. Every shot is an opportunity to reveal the hidden beauty of everyday life, to celebrate the diversity of cultures and to freeze timeless memories. In 2024, after nearly 8 years of dedication to her art, Cynthia continues to sublimate the world around her, blending creativity and emotion in each of her projects.

main.title: Visual poetry in pixels
main.text: Step into a visual journey that encapsulates the essence of my lens.
